units.temperature_range_k: K; null means the source gives no fit range
units.molecular_energy: J per particle; supplied by the caller, not a gas constant

limitations: Neutral species and elastic collision parameters only; no chemistry, ionization or internal energy relaxation model is supplied.
Reference datasets are starting points, not universal parameter recommendations.
VHS and VSS fits are independent. Changing alpha alone does not convert a fitted parameter set.
Atlas uses arithmetic means of species collision parameters for unlike collisions; these are not independently fitted binary interaction data.
Published pure-gas temperature fit ranges do not validate mixture properties.
A reference temperature is not a validity interval. No temperature extrapolation is validated by this catalog.
Some species have only a VHS preset; unavailable VSS coefficients are not invented.
Preset masses preserve the rounding of their identified mass sources.
